critical_blockers.title: URL migration: live site is on legacy slugs, new theme is not
critical_blockers.detail: Live site serves /conoce-casa-de-piedra/ and /zona-de-restaurantes/. The new theme (inc/seo.php) canonicalises /espacios/ and /restaurantes/. /zona-de-restaurantes/ is currently the single strongest organic asset on the domain: it ranks position 1 for 'restaurantes Casa de Piedra' and for 'mejores restaurantes Cerro Gordo alta cocina'. /conoce-casa-de-piedra/ ranks position 1 for 'Casa de Piedra León eventos bodas' and 'salón de eventos Cerro Gordo León'.
critical_blockers.action: 301 /conoce-casa-de-piedra/ -> /espacios/ and /zona-de-restaurantes/ -> /restaurantes/ at launch. Do not soft-404 or redirect both to homepage.

critical_blockers.title: Restaurant roster conflict between theme data and every external source
critical_blockers.detail: Theme default_data / SKILL.md list: Argentilia, Lucio Ítalo-Argentino, Manolo, Sato, Valentina. Live site and all third-party sources list: Sato, Argentilia, Buenavista, La Cocinoteca, Corazón de Alcachofa, Agaves Casa de Piedra (live page text says 'siete restaurantes'). Lucio, Manolo and Valentina appear in zero external sources; Buenavista, La Cocinoteca, Corazón de Alcachofa and Agaves appear in zero theme sources.
critical_blockers.action: Confirm the current tenant roster with the client before publishing /restaurantes/ children. Publishing non-existent Restaurant schema nodes is an entity-trust and AEO risk.

critical_blockers.title: Capacity figures conflict between theme and all published sources
critical_blockers.detail: inc/seo.php FAQ and SKILL.md state Jardín Principal 1,500 and Salón Principal 800. Live site, VIVA LEÓN, lugaresparaeventos.mx and bodas.com.mx all state Jardín Principal 2,000 and Salón Principal 1,000, plus Terraza del Mezquite 200 and Salón Pavorreales 70 (empresarial) / 100 (auditorio).
critical_blockers.action: Pick one authoritative set and propagate to FAQPage schema, maximumAttendeeCapacity, /espacios/ children and the empresariales page. Capacity is the primary filter query for this vertical; inconsistency costs both rankings and AI answer inclusion.

critical_blockers.title: NAP citation drift in high-authority directories
critical_blockers.detail: bodas.com.mx lists 'Blvd. Juan Alonso de Torres 2002, Col. Valle del Campestre 37150' (Plaza Mayor address, not the venue). turismo.hotmarketing.net lists 'Av. Cerrada Cerro Gordo 270, El Campestre, 37150'. Canonical NAP is Av. Cerro Gordo 270, Casa de Piedra, 37120 León de los Aldama, Gto. Colonia also varies across sources (Casa de Piedra / Valle del Campestre / Club Campestre / Jardines del Campestre).
critical_blockers.action: Citation cleanup on bodas.com.mx, turismo.hotmarketing.net, unilocal.es. Lock one colonia string in schema, footer, GBP and llms.txt.

clusters.name: Bodas
clusters.thin_content_verdict: NOT thin, conditional on content gate below
clusters.justification: bodas.com.mx maintains a distinct /haciendas-para-bodas/ category path separate from /jardines-para-bodas/ and /salones-para-bodas/, and Casa de Piedra already ranks in it. The 'hacienda' qualifier is a genuine style-intent modifier, not a synonym. The page has unique substance available to it that /espacios/ cannot carry: the 1845 founding, the ceremony-to-reception flow across Jardín Principal into Salón Principal, wedding-specific capacity tiers, banquet integration with the on-site restaurants, and valet parking.
content_gate: Minimum 1,200 words of wedding-specific copy. Zero sentences copy-pasted from /espacios/.
At least 8 real wedding photographs from the venue, not stock and not reused from the galería grid verbatim.
A ceremony + reception flow narrative naming the specific spaces and the transition between them.
Capacity and pricing-range guidance grounded in real numbers (BLK-03 must be resolved first).
FAQPage with at least 5 questions answerable only by this venue (music curfew, descorche, capilla/ceremonia civil, proveedor externo policy, parking count).
If any two gate items cannot be met, do not ship the page. Add a bodas section to /espacios/ instead.
clusters.schema: WebPage + Service (serviceType: Wedding venue) + FAQPage, provider -> Organization @id

clusters.name: Eventos empresariales y convenciones
clusters.thin_content_verdict: NOT thin. Highest-confidence recommendation in this plan.
clusters.justification: The corporate SERP has ZERO shared URLs with every social-event SERP tested. It is owned by Poliforum León and hotel meeting-space pages (Real de Minas, Courtyard by Marriott, HS Hotsson), all of which publish capacity tables by montaje. Casa de Piedra currently has no page competing in that SERP at all, and the homepage cannot rank there because it signals social-events intent. Corporate buyers also search on entirely different attributes (montaje auditorio/escuela/herradura, m², AV, wifi, parking count) which do not belong on a social-events page.
content_gate: Capacity table by montaje (auditorio, escuela, herradura, banquete, cóctel) for Salón Principal and Salón Pavorreales, mirroring how every ranking competitor presents the data. This is the single highest-leverage element.
m² per space, AV/connectivity inventory, valet and parking capacity.
Business-lunch and coffee-break angle linking to /restaurantes/ — a differentiator no hotel or convention centre in this SERP has in the same form.
Distance/access framing: zona norte, cerca de Plaza Mayor, vs the Poliforum corridor.
FAQPage with 5+ corporate-specific questions (facturación, horarios de montaje, señal de internet dedicada, proveedores AV externos).
clusters.schema: WebPage + Service (serviceType: Corporate event venue) + FAQPage. Consider EventVenue with maximumAttendeeCapacity per montaje.

rejected_pages.rationale: SERP overlap with 'salón de fiestas León' is 4 and with 'graduaciones León' is 4 — the same neighbourhood /espacios/ already targets. Competitors do run dedicated XV subpaths, so the page-type is viable, but on a ~10-URL site a third occasion page drawing from the same four physical spaces starts to read as templated. Serve XV años as a section on /espacios/ plus a galería category first. Revisit only if GSC shows XV impressions with no adequate landing page after 90 days, and only with genuinely XV-specific content (vals space, chambelanes staging, package tiers).
Same SERP neighbourhood as XV años. Serve as a section plus galería category.

Classic doorway pattern. These are low-differentiation occasions that would all describe Terraza Mezquite and Salón Pavorreales. Cover them as an occasion list on /espacios/ and in the venue-profile 'ideal para' blocks.

'salón Cerro Gordo León' already resolves to Casa de Piedra's own pages plus its directory profiles (4 shared URLs with the brand query). The hub and /espacios/ already win it. A geo page would cannibalise the hub.
Keyword-variant duplicates of /espacios/ and /espacios/jardin-principal/. Guaranteed cannibalisation.

casa_opt_status_eventos is 0 and inc/seo.php correctly noindexes it. An empty or near-empty archive is index bloat. Enable only when there is a real, recurring calendar of published events. Note that /bodas/ and /eventos-empresariales/ are deliberately flat pages so they carry no dependency on this CPT.
Explicitly out of scope. A single-location venue has one address and four spaces. There is no data dimension to scale on, and the thin-content and index-bloat risk is total.

checks.action: Hub title must lead with the brand-and-complex framing ('Casa de Piedra León | Jardín, salones y restaurantes'). /espacios/ owns the generic 'salón de eventos en León' head term. inc/seo.php currently sets the homepage title to 'Jardín de eventos en León | Casa de Piedra' and /espacios/ to 'Salones de eventos en León | Casa de Piedra' — these are close enough to compete. Differentiate: give the jardín head term to /espacios/jardin-principal/ or to /espacios/, not to both the hub and a child.

social_events_serp.character: Directory-dominated. Own-site venue pages rank below aggregators.
social_events_serp.implication: Own-site pages win on entity depth and freshness, not on breadth. Also treat the directory profiles as a distribution channel — Casa de Piedra already has profiles on bodas.com.mx, lugaresparaeventos.mx, leon-mexico.com and turismo.hotmarketing.net. Keeping those accurate is as valuable as the on-site work, and BLK-04 shows they are currently wrong.

corporate_serp.character: Own-site pages dominate. No directory layer.
corporate_serp.implication: Winnable with one well-built page. Every ranking competitor publishes a montaje capacity table — that is the table-stakes content element, and Casa de Piedra's 1,000-person Salón Principal plus 100-person auditorio Pavorreales are competitive against the hotel tier.

gastronomy_serp.character: Own-site page already ranks position 1, supported by review and menu aggregators.
gastronomy_serp.implication: Defend, do not rebuild. The migration in BLK-01 is the only real risk to this cluster.
